title: Example: indirect commitments and a handoff

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: The client still needs the revised proposal. Can someone pick it up?

segments.speaker: Juan
segments.text: Leave it with me, once finance approves the figures.

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Great, thanks. Nathalia, could you chase that approval?

segments.speaker: Nathalia
segments.text: Sure, I will ask finance this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Juan
segments.text: Actually, I am away tomorrow. Ana, can you send the proposal instead?

segments.speaker: Ana
segments.text: Yes, once the numbers are approved.

segments.speaker: Nathalia
segments.text: We could also redesign the dashboard someday, but it is only an idea. Let's keep that out of this week's work.

segments.speaker: Juan
segments.text: And the old export bug? That's already fixed. No follow-up needed.
